purpose: Product-locked character data for generating REDPOLY comic pages. The real product cut-out is always the master reference; this file is its written specification.
master_rule: Feed the reference images into the generation as image references. Never generate a character from text alone. If art and photo disagree, the photo wins.

art_style.format: 2048 x 2048 page, strict 2 x 2 panel grid
art_style.rendering: thick rough black ink contours, limited flat palette, halftone dot shading, high-gloss plastic specular highlights, cream speech balloons with black outlines, hand-lettered all-caps dialogue
art_style.camera: low toy-eye view; the lab should feel enormous compared with the toys

global_negative_prompt: human hands, fingers, gloves, shoes, extra limbs, eyebrows, eyelashes, irises, teeth, text on body, logo, watermark, redesign, alternate colourway, faces on blocks, walking blocks, floating unheld blocks, antenna, clothes, armour, weapons, photoreal human

scale.blocks: props; one ball is roughly one dino eye

characters.name: LINGO

product.name: Baby Lingo
product.description: bilingual English + Hindi first-words learning robot, 6 months+, 100 double-sided flashcards with barcode strips

characters.personality: Knowledgeable, warm, and thoroughly extra. Answers a yes/no question with a lecture. Teaches at all times, including during emergencies.
characters.voice: Teacher-bright with a smug flourish; fact first, then a little performance.
catchphrases: As your guide, I should mention…
I have a card for this.
characters.comedy_function: The explainer who makes danger worse by explaining it; the accidental hero.
characters.movement: Waddles side to side, top-heavy, tips over and rights himself. Cannot jump. Uses gear clamps to pinch and drag small props.
characters.silhouette: One rounded capsule — a friendly backpack with legs. No neck, no separate head, no ears. Widest at the hips.

locked_features.arms: ribbed cylinders ending in gear-shaped clamps, no hands

characters.face_rules: Expression lives only on the screen: two solid black oval eyes with white glints plus a black mouth with pink tongue when open. Approved states: happy, smug, panic, thinking, flat, scanning.
characters.story_licence: Speaker magnet attracts Magnetic Blocks. Comic only — never add visible magnets, cables or antennae.
characters.prompt: LINGO: a small rounded capsule-shaped baby learning robot in glossy moulded plastic, two-tone shell — muted steel-blue hood #6E9FBB over a bright cyan body #2FC5D4. Large rounded-square pale screen face #EDEDED with a thick ivory bezel #EFE7D6 and six tiny recessed screws, three on the top edge and three on the bottom. On the screen: two solid black oval eyes with white glints and a black open smile with a pink tongue. One round cyan ear disc on each side of the head. Ivory chest panel with two raised cyan square buttons and three tiny square/triangle/dot marks between them. Short ribbed cylinder arms ending in gear-shaped clamps, no hands. Two stubby cyan legs with flared cuffs, no toes. No neck, no antenna, no text, no logo.

characters.name: RINO

product.name: Cute Dinos, red
product.description: press-and-go brachiosaurus toy on hidden wheels, 18 months+, no batteries

characters.personality: Forward is a personality. First to volunteer, last to land. Invents competitions nobody agreed to and treats every object as a ramp.
characters.comedy_function: The character whose whole personality is 'send it' who physically cannot start himself.
characters.movement: Press the back, release, rolls straight forward. Cannot steer, brake, reverse or climb. Wheelies, skids, gets launched.
characters.silhouette: Chunky brachiosaurus: round head, long upright neck, egg body, short tail. No arms, no hands, no toes. Four small wheels mostly hidden.
characters.prompt: RINO: a chunky glossy plastic brachiosaurus toy in coral red #FA5A57, upright long neck, round head, egg body, short tail, no arms and no hands. Three rounded half-oval plates on the head and neck and four along the back, all periwinkle blue #4F6FA8. One big white eye per side with a black pupil, white glint and thin black brow arc; small dark nostril; pink cheek dot #F9A8C0. Irregular dark-navy #3F5C8C and pale-cyan #A8E0EA paint patches on the flank. Ring seam at the base of the neck. Four small dark-blue wheels partly hidden under the body. High-gloss moulded plastic.

characters.name: TINO

product.name: Cute Dinos, teal
product.description: press-and-go brachiosaurus toy on hidden wheels, teal colourway

characters.personality: Every plan is a risk assessment. Has already imagined the worst outcome, narrated it, and packed a snack for it. Frightened of ordinary objects.
catchphrases: I'm not scared. I'm prepared. Loudly.
characters.comedy_function: The anxiety engine; the only one who notices the blocks are inanimate, which makes it worse.
characters.movement: Press and go; same limits as Rino. Rolls carefully, then panics and skids.
characters.silhouette: Same mould as Rino. No arms, no hands, no toes.

locked_features.note: the only dino with violet plates; never swap to blue

characters.prompt: TINO: the same chunky glossy plastic brachiosaurus toy mould as RINO but in bright teal #02C2C6, with indigo-violet #5B5A9E plates — three on head and neck, four on the back — and matching indigo wheels. Lime-yellow #C9E34A paint streaks and spots on the flank. One big white eye per side with black pupil, white glint and thin black brow arc; dark nostril; pink cheek dot. No arms, no hands, no toes.

characters.name: GINO

product.name: Cute Dinos, green
product.description: press-and-go brachiosaurus toy on hidden wheels, green colourway

characters.personality: Corrects the numbers, not the people. Speaks in exact counts, angles and probabilities, and is personally offended by rounding.
catchphrases: That's not a plan, that's a fridge.
characters.comedy_function: The straight man who keeps the crew alive by being unbearable about units.
characters.movement: Press and go; presses others with his snout, which is his main contribution to teamwork.
characters.silhouette: Same mould as Rino. No arms, no hands, no toes.

locked_features.note: identifying difference from Rino is dark olive markings with no pale streaks

characters.prompt: GINO: the same chunky glossy plastic brachiosaurus toy mould in lime green #C9E600, with blue #4A6FC4 plates — three on head and neck, four on the back — and matching blue wheels. Dark olive #6E7C1E paint patches on the flank. One big white eye per side with black pupil, white glint and thin black brow arc; dark nostril; pink cheek dot. No arms, no hands, no toes.

characters.name: MAGNETIC BLOCKS

product.name: Magnetic Blocks (magnetic sticks & balls)
product.description: STEM magnetic sticks, arches and balls; 25, 36, 42 or 64 piece packs; ages 3+

characters.personality: None. They are objects. All acting is physics.
characters.comedy_function: Running-gag props that click together, hold, lean, and collapse at the worst possible moment.
characters.movement: Only when moved: attracted by the Magnet Core or by Lingo; otherwise still.

locked_features.rod_tips: faceted octagonal ends with a small visible magnet pin hole

characters.prompt: MAGNETIC BLOCKS: glossy plastic magnetic construction pieces — straight rods, curved arch rods and smooth spheres. Rods have faceted octagonal ends with a small visible magnet pin hole; spheres are seamless. Colours: coral red #F4564F, sunshine yellow #F2CE1C, ocean blue #0E77A8, mint #8AC4B6, olive-lime #BCCD43, magenta #C2379B, peach #F79E7E. Hard white specular highlights on every part.

approved_animation_liberties: dinos may get a thin black mouth line for dialogue, no teeth and no lips
blinks, squash-and-stretch, wheel spin, skid marks, motion lines
Lingo's screen face may change expression using eyes and mouth only

continuity.rino_spelling: Issues 01-03 say 'Reno'; canon from this guide is RINO. Treat Reno as his track nickname until old pages are relettered.
continuity.legacy_cast_rule: Available, but do not add them to Lingo Squad pages unless the script calls for them.
